free_tier.stated: 'Upload files instantly and share secure download links. Free file upload platform with fast speeds, large file support, and no sign-up required.'
free_tier.notes: No free allowance is printed; the premium block is what names a number.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not stated on the page read

egress.terms: Premium: '30-Day Premium 50.00 GB/day'. The four things premium buys are listed as 'Faster download speed', 'No waiting or countdowns', 'High-volume daily traffic', 'Ad-free experience'.

interface_detail: Web upload with no signup required for free use; premium is attached to an account. No API published.
tooling: Browser only as read. The host is on the Leechall generator list, which is the scripted path found.
chaining: 50 GB/day for $14.99 is the cheapest per-GB-per-day after Drop Download, and the free tier needs no account at all, which makes it the lowest-identity way to hand a file to somebody.

limits.value: 50 GB per day on the 30-day premium
free tier has a wait/countdown and an ad layer; premium removes both

limits_note: Only one paid period ($14.99 / 30 days) is offered on the page read; there is no annual plan and no traffic top-up.
binding_note: 50 GB/day is 1.46 TB a month, above the 1 TiB target. Nothing in the vocabulary fails at a user's  scale on premium; the free tier has no published number to bind against.

identity_cost.detail: Payment methods on the premium page: credit card through Stripe (two variants, 'No Fees' and 'Low Fees'), Byteseller, PayPal through Patreon, and Apple/Google Pay. Free upload needs no account.

reliability_note: The free tier needs no account, so a link has no owner to appeal to; a removal cannot be contested by the uploader.
confidence_note: Price and daily volume read on the vendor premium page today. The free tier's actual ceiling and the per-file cap are unread.

evidence.proved: '30-Day Premium 50.00 GB/day · One-time · No subscription $14.99', the four premium features, and the payment list
'no sign-up required' for free upload and the free account offer

notes: The Stripe 'Low Fees' variant exists because the 'No Fees' variant passes the processor cost on; the checkout totals differ by the fee, not the plan.

extras.payments: Stripe (No Fees / Low Fees), Byteseller, PayPal via Patreon, Apple/Google Pay
